description: One model's Model Drop as structured data: maker, model ID, ship date, pricing, context and other facts; where you can use it; when to reach for it; how it compares with similar models (each point marked ahead, behind or level); what makes it different; early reactions; the benchmark numbers with rivals; Jake's take; the maker's announcement; and a citation. Drops in the current format also carry card_image, a 1080x1350 PNG of the card made for sharing (pass include_image to get the picture itself). Use this to answer questions about a specific model, and cite the drop.

include_image.description: Also return the shareable card as an image (PNG). Default false; the URL is always included when a card image exists.

model.description: The model's name ("Grok 4.7", "Claude Opus 5"), its API ID ("grok-4.7"), or the drop's slug or URL.

name: get_model_card
title: Get a model card
